look.why: A lush Bornean mangrove-river teal that sets off the cinnamon-orange coat, white tail and fleshy pink nose.

size.measure: head to tail tip, about 1.35 m for an adult male (body 66–76 cm plus 55–75 cm white tail per ADW)

habitat.text: Coastal mangrove forests, peat swamps and riverine forests strictly near water on the island of Borneo.

diet.text: Young mangrove leaves, unripe fruits, seeds and shoots digested in a specialized multi-chambered stomach.

facts.text: Adult males grow a fleshy nose over 10 cm long that amplifies honking calls to attract mates and warn rivals.
They are the finest swimmers among all primates, with partially webbed toes and leaps straight into rivers from 15 meters up.

id.habitat: Hutan bakau (mangrove) pesisir, rawa gambut, dan hutan tepi sungai di Pulau Kalimantan.
id.diet: Daun muda mangrove, buah mentah, biji-bijian, dan pucuk tanaman yang dicerna dalam lambung beruang banyak.
facts: Pejantan dewasa memiliki hidung besar menggantung sepanjang lebih dari 10 cm yang memperkuat suara panggilan untuk menarik pasangan.
Perenang terbaik di antara semua primata, dengan jari kaki berselaput dan kemampuan melompat ke sungai dari ketinggian 15 meter.
